handback.t:
KNOWLEDGE is done: retrieval-before-route works, but only the feature path is safe. The vote path hurts when context recurs but is irrelevant. `cargo test --release --lib` is green (191 passed, 0 failed, including 6 new knowledge tests).

**What was built**
- `src/knowledge.rs` is a retrieval layer over `memory::SharedMemory` (FlatIndex). `tiered::TieredMemory` also works as a backend; it is covered by one unit test only, not by any d6 run.
- Before routing it embeds the task and pulls the top-k records. Neighbours at or above `sim_min` vote for a context anchor, and the anchor is injected as a `kn:<anchor>` feature.
  - Hidden mode: only the inner Hebbian learner sees the feature, so Guarded keeps gating on the original features.
  - Direct mode: the front sees it too.
- A second injection path is an agent vote from per-anchor reward stats. A confident vote short-cuts the front, behind a self-check gate. The gate suppresses the vote while its realised mean reward trails the front's.
- Learn by doing: `KnowledgeRouter.update` credits the retrieved record with the same reward the front receives.
- The optional fetch interface is a `SourceFetcher` trait with `NoFetch` (stub, always returns `Disabled`), `FixtureFetcher` (test double), an `ApprovedSources` allow-list guard, and `ingest_from`. There is no network code.
- `src/bin/d6_knowledge.rs` is the lab. The worlds are my own construction: sim.rs worlds plus a recurring embedding context that sets part of the true skill.
  - Treatment worlds: ctx-strong-fixed, ctx-mild-random, ctx-noisy-emb.
  - Controls: ctl-irrelevant-ctx (context recurs but does not matter), ctl-unique-ctx (matters but never recurs), ctl-none-random (neither).
- Two regimes: O gives everyone realised-outcome feedback, to isolate retrieval. W is the x3 weak-feedback setup, where baselines get the raw hook bit and the knowledge loop gets the delayed reuse signal behind Guarded.
- Protocol: tuned on seeds 1-8, held-out 31-60, frozen confirmation 61-90. CIs are paired 95% t, with Holm correction, against the best fair baseline.

**Results at H2000**
- **Retrieval raises success when context recurs and matters.** Figures are 31-60 | 61-90.

| World, regime | kn-feat(hidden) | kn-direct+vote |
|---|---|---|
| ctx-strong, O | +0.067 \| +0.067 | +0.169 \| +0.178 |
| ctx-strong, W | +0.030 \| +0.033 | +0.059 \| +0.067 |
| ctx-noisy-emb, O | +0.034 \| +0.036 (vs guarded; WIN) | +0.100 \| +0.099 (vs guarded; WIN) |

  - ctx-strong rows are against the best fair baseline (W: against keyword) and all Holm wins.
  - Nothing is lost at H100.
  - ctx-noisy-emb in W is a Holm win only for the vote variant (+0.025 | +0.033).
- **Mild context does not reliably help.** ctx-mild-random is within ±0.006 of the best baseline and not significant after Holm. The vote variants show small early losses on 31-60.
- **Learn-by-doing holds with the knowledge layer.** Inside the same layer, the graded delayed reuse signal beats the raw hook bit by +0.04 to +0.17 (all Holm wins). The exception is ctl-unique-ctx, where reuse is 0.018 worse. Reuse behind Guarded stays the default feedback path.
- **Harm to report.** In ctl-irrelevant-ctx, kn-direct+vote costs about 0.02 to 0.025 on both seed sets (Holm significant). An ungated vote cost 0.09-0.11. kn-feat(hidden) is not significantly harmful against its own front on 61-90; on 31-60 it is −0.011 in W (Holm 0.01) and not significant in O.
- **Unique-context and no-context controls.** Knowledge equals its front to within 0.003. The losses against the best baseline in ctl-unique-ctx are the Guarded learner losing to keyword, not retrieval.
- **Totals against the best fair baseline** (31-60 | 61-90): Holm wins/losses are 15/24 | 19/25 in O and 7/40 | 6/36 in W. Most losses come from the controls and the raw-signal ablation. Against the same front without knowledge, the counts are 22/9 | 21/10 in O and 16/9 | 15/6 in W.

**Other negatives**
- A `sim_min` of 0.5 produced spurious anchors in the unique-embedding control at dim 32. The grid was changed to 0.6 and 0.7, and 0.6 was selected.
- Satisficing exploration cost far more than it gained and was not selected.
- Gains appear from H500 onward. The learner stays well below oracle (about 0.64 against 0.77 in ctx-strong).
- Real embeddings were not tested. `hash_embed` exists and is unit-tested only.

**Recommendation:** opt-in only. Use kn-feat(hidden) behind Guarded as the safe default. Enable the vote only when context is known to matter.

- `pub mod coupling;` was missing from `lib.rs` when I started, so `x3_coupling` would not have built. I re-added it, as the task allowed.
- `pub mod addons;` is present.
